steps: Sign up as a participant at playbookux.com ('Sign up to give feedback').
Complete the unpaid practice test and wait for approval.
Browse and accept unmoderated studies that match your profile (pass any screener).
Record your screen and voice while thinking aloud through the tasks in a quiet room.
Receive $10 via PayPal within 8 days of completing the study.
timing: Payment via PayPal within 8 days of completing the study (official FAQ).

repeatable.cadence: new unmoderated studies appear whenever your profile matches one — you can take each matched study after passing any screener

maximize: Pass the unpaid practice test first — no paid studies come before it. Keep your PlaybookUX profile complete so screeners match you to studies. Each 10-20 minute unmoderated session pays $10, and payment arrives via PayPal within 8 days of completion. Check for invites regularly since volume is profile-dependent.
who_pays: PlaybookUX pays you via PayPal automatically after each study. There’s no payout threshold — track payments in the ‘Completed Tests’ tab.
who_qualifies: Anyone — studies are matched by your profile and screener answers. You need a desktop (OS X 10.8+/Windows 8/10) or a mobile device (iOS 13+/Android 7.0+) with the PlaybookUX app downloaded, and you must pass the unpaid practice test first.
work_available: Invite-based and profile-dependent — you get invites when studies match your demographics, and volume is not guaranteed.
what_gets_accepted: Submit a clean, well-completed session: record your screen and voice while thinking aloud in a quiet room and complete all tasks. Noisy background or poor think-aloud quality can get your submission rejected with no pay.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Free to join, no fees. Unpaid time: the practice test is unpaid and must be approved before you can take paid studies; you also spend unpaid time on screeners and waiting for invites.
when_cash_arrives: Via PayPal within 8 days of completing the study.
